== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Grave]] [[Hound]] is a summoned beast rather than a person. Known to be the founder of Escalon and the pilot of [[The Last Horizon]], this entity is also identified as [[Omega]]. [[The Grave]] [[Hound]]'s presence inspires significant fear in others, including Planetary [[Security]], and some believe that people will offer concessions just to ensure the entity remains on their side. While some individuals express distrust toward it, others have attempted to negotiate with it directly. [[The Grave]] [[Hound]] has been held in captivity within a [[spell-anchor]] using a [[technique]] called [[Absolute Burial]], which suppresses a victim's physical strength, magical connections, powers, and thoughts. There are mentions of the entity having a daughter and requiring a leash.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Grave]] [[Hound]], also known as [[Omega]], is an entity that has requested the [[destruction]] of [[Solstice]]. This individual's actions have led Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri to view them with distrust.}}
